root_idea.summary: The root centers on slowness or delay in an affair, movement, or progress.
root_idea.development: From the basic state of being slow or late, the derived family extends to making another lag, deliberately lingering or holding back, and judging another slow.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form بَطَّأَ rather than the attested imperfect form.

senses.definition: To hold another back or dissuade him, causing him to delay or lag.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative use: the delayed or impeded person may be expressed or understood from context.

senses.definition: To lag behind or repeatedly hold oneself back.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the form is also explained as self-directed hesitation or persistent hanging back rather than as causing another person to lag.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become slow, tardy, delayed, or late, especially in movement, progress, or coming.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb; it can describe slowness as a characteristic or lateness in going or arrival. Its verbal nouns include بُطْءٌ, بَطَاءَةٌ, and بِطَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become slow; of riding beasts, to be or become slow in movement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use attested for beasts being ridden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect or pretend to be slow; to linger, delay, or hold oneself back from work or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VI construction that may express affected slowness as well as actual sluggishness or delay.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deem or reckon someone slow, tardy, or dilatory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form X evaluation of another person's promptness or pace.
A verbal noun of بَطُؤَ; variant verbal-noun forms include بَطَاءَةٌ and بِطَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a dialectal idiom, ever or throughout all time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In لَمْ أَفْعَلْهُ بُطْءًا يَا هَذَا, the expression means, literally, that it was never done ever.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an exclamatory expression: how slow this is in coming forth!
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare expression of wonder, also reported as بَطْآنَ, equivalent in force to مَا أَبْطَأَهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Slow, tardy, dilatory, late, or backward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a person, a horse, or a similar being; its plural is بَطَاءٌ.

cautions: The Quranic occurrence in 4:72 has two closely related lexical interpretations: causing others to lag and itself hanging back; both are represented above.
